name: Audiology & Speech Therapy
title: BASLP — Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology
intro: The BASLP route: eligibility, entrance, four years, internship and RCI registration.

phases.title: Class 11–12 prerequisites
phases.summary: Science with Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Maths.
points: Most programmes require Class 12 Science (PCB or PCM) with English.
Minimum marks are usually 50%.
Good communication and listening skills are essential.
Look at institutes recognised by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI).

phases.title: Entrance and admission
points: Leading institutes like AIISH Mysuru and others conduct their own admission tests or use CUET-UG scores.
Check each institute’s notification for eligibility and dates.
Attend counselling and choose an RCI-recognised college.
Verify documents and pay fees.

phases.title: Three years of academics
phases.summary: Anatomy of speech and hearing, audiology and speech-language pathology.
points: Year 1: Anatomy and Physiology of speech and hearing, Acoustics, Linguistics.
Year 2: Audiological Assessment, Speech and Language Disorders, Hearing Aids.
Year 3: Voice and Fluency Disorders, Paediatric Audiology, Neurogenic Disorders and Cochlear Implants.
Clinical practicum runs alongside theory.

phases.title: One-year clinical internship
phases.summary: Supervised clinical work in hospitals and clinics.
points: Assess hearing, fit hearing aids and treat speech and language disorders under supervision.
Maintain a clinical logbook.
Rotate through audiology, speech therapy, paediatric and adult clinics.
Finish the internship before degree award.

phases.title: RCI registration and careers
points: RCI registration (CRR number) is mandatory to practise in India.
Jobs: audiologist, speech-language pathologist, special educator support and hearing-aid specialist.
Higher study: MASLP, PhD.
Work settings include hospitals, schools and private clinics.
